description: This file contains a custom assertion class `JsonPointerAssert` for verifying properties of `JsonPointer` objects, using AssertJ framework. It provides methods to check level count, emptiness, equality, presence or absence of keys, and specific root or leaf elements of JSON pointers.

classes.name: JsonPointerAssert
classes.description: A final class extending AssertJ's AbstractAssert, providing fluent assertions for JsonPointer objects, including key presence checks, structural assertions, and equality comparisons.

methods.name: hasLevelCount
methods.description: Verifies that the JsonPointer has the expected number of levels.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks that the JsonPointer is empty.

methods.name: isNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks that the JsonPointer is not empty.

methods.name: isEqualTo
methods.description: Asserts that the actual JsonPointer equals the expected object.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks that the JsonPointer contains specified key(s).

methods.name: doesNotContainKey
methods.description: Checks that the JsonPointer does not contain specified key(s).

methods.name: hasRoot
methods.description: Verifies the root key of the JsonPointer.

methods.name: hasLeaf
methods.description: Verifies the leaf key of the JsonPointer.
